Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by Tanubrata, Sutanto, Fahmi, Bambang, dan Rekan, granting discharge of liability to the Board.
Agenda #2: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint a Public Accountant and Firm for the 2026 audit and determine their remuneration.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was granted the authority to determine the 2026 fiscal year salaries, honorarium, and allowances for both the Board of Commissioners and Directors.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved a dividend distribution of IDR 52 per share from the 2025 net profit, with USD 10.1 million retained as earnings.
Agenda #5: Shareholders accepted the resignation of Arif Rachmat and approved the appointment of Bambang Irawan as a new Commissioner effective June 18, 2026.
